title: Skip zone and scatter
idea: Between where the ground wave dies out and where the sky wave first comes down is the skip zone. Scatter leaks a little energy into it: weak, fluttery and distorted.

rows: Nothing: the sky wave jumps over

compare.how: Only a small part of the energy is scattered into the skip zone.
It arrives through several different paths at once.

traps.wrong: There are very large, sudden swings in signal strength
traps.why: Scatter is a fast flutter on a weak signal, not big swings.

traps.wrong: The ionospheric region involved is unstable
traps.why: The distortion comes from several paths arriving out of step.

traps.wrong: Propagation is via ground waves, which absorb most of the signal energy
traps.why: The skip zone is past the ground wave's reach. Scatter is weak because only a little energy is scattered there.
Short path is a direction around the globe, not a way into the skip zone.
